title: Headless workers measured and landed cleanly
goal: Headless delegated worker sessions are measured and land cleanly: a worker session started in the worktree of an item the orchestrator claimed opens that item's work window, so backlog.py cost counts its prompts; the delegation sentences of kb-sprint run step 3, kb/_self/backlog.md Running a sprint and kb-worker.md say that the project settings' SessionStart intake hook leaves untracked drafts the orchestrator moves aside before land, that staging copies of .claude/ files sit outside the worker's worktree, and which permission mode refuses a .claude/ write; kb/_self/usage.md says the kb's own headless runs pass disableAllHooks
